name: potion-bottle
description: A potion bottle standing on y = 0: a hollow glass round flask, tall vial or conical flask with a lip at the neck, a coloured liquid inside to the fill level (red, blue, green or purple, glowing or not), a tapered cork, and a paper tag tied round the neck with twine.

params.name: shape
params.description: 0 = round flask, 1 = tall vial, 2 = conical (Erlenmeyer) flask.

params.name: height
params.description: Height of the glass bottle (without the cork), in metres.

params.name: neck
params.description: Length of the neck as a share of the height.

params.name: fill
params.description: How full the body is (share of the body height).

params.name: liquid
params.description: Colour of the potion: 0 = red (health), 1 = blue (mana), 2 = green (poison), 3 = purple.

params.name: cork
params.description: A cork in the neck (otherwise the bottle is open).

params.name: label
params.description: A paper tag tied round the neck with twine.
